pairs.subject: modal-stack
pairs.evidence: src/features/templates/sub_generated/gallery/modals/TemplateDetailModal.tsx:310 hard-deletes a template with no confirm or undo and closes at :311 before the await settles, so a failure is only logged (src/features/templates/sub_generated/gallery/cards/useGalleryActions.ts:208); 5 of 5 applicable techniques fail, anchored-positioning not-applicable

techniques.evidence: src/features/templates/sub_generated/gallery/modals/useModalStack.ts:37 a private feature stack closes by type, not by minted id, and src/features/templates/sub_generated/gallery/modals/TemplateModals.tsx:112 renders the credential modal from separate state outside the stack, so render is a fixed JSX order rather than a fold over the stack

src/features/templates/sub_generated/gallery/modals/RebuildModal.tsx:72 passes a bare onClose to BaseModal, whose backdrop (src/lib/ui/BaseModal.tsx:283) closes unconditionally, so a stray click discards the typed rebuild direction (textarea at src/features/templates/sub_generated/gallery/modals/RebuildModal.tsx:116) with no dirty guard and no cancel/dismiss distinction

src/features/templates/sub_generated/gallery/modals/TemplateDetailModal.tsx:122 returns null before BaseModal ever sees isOpen=false, so the focus-return effect at src/lib/ui/BaseModal.tsx:231 never runs and focus is dropped to body on close; no scroll lock or background inertness either

src/features/templates/sub_generated/gallery/modals/TemplateDetailModal.tsx:145 hard-codes containerClassName with z-50, which switches off the depth-derived zIndex at src/lib/ui/BaseModal.tsx:278, so the detail modal ranks by a hand-picked number instead of the shared scale and stack depth
src/features/templates/sub_generated/gallery/modals/TemplateDetailModal.tsx:310 an irreversible delete runs on one click with neither a confirmation nor an undo
src/features/templates/sub_generated/gallery/modals/TemplateModals.tsx:62 every overlay in this context is a centered BaseModal dialog; none is anchored to a control

pairs.registryProposal: Upward note for stack-ownership's registry variant: src/lib/ui/BaseModal.tsx:157 joins an app-wide registry (useModalStackPosition) that answers isTopmost/depth and gates Escape correctly, yet a feature can still defeat its layering by overriding the container class (TemplateDetailModal.tsx:145). The technique could name 'an escape hatch on the primitive that bypasses the registry's z derivation' as a failure form of the registry variant.
